title: Event Card
description: One decision card. Documented facts are fixed; only consequences branch on player choice.

id.description: Stable kebab-case key. Never reused, never renumbered.

order.description: Chronological slot within the level. Must be consistent with `year`.

year.description: Gregorian year of the underlying real event. null ONLY when historicity = invented.

showYear.description: False when the year is an ordering year only (marked b in the level map) and must never be printed in a player facing string; the card then shows its title alone. Card 7: the burning of the village has no sourced year.

title.description: The event's short name (2 to 5 words), shown beside the year on the card and on its outcome. Names the moment plainly; the year carries the history.

historicity.description: Maps 1:1 onto the three buckets Report section 2 must declare: authentic / simplified for gameplay / creative reinterpretation.

sources.description: At least one source per card. Cards with historicity=invented still need the source for the surrounding context they sit in.

tags.description: Free labels for the How-To-Play search/filter requirement, e.g. craft, custom, market, transmission.

appearsIf.description: Gate. Omit for cards always eligible.

oneShot.description: false only for generic pressure cards that may repeat.

historicalNote.description: What actually happened. Shown after EITHER choice, unchanged. This is the accuracy guarantee: the player's counterfactual never overwrites the record.

type.description: encyclopedia (e.g. Wikipedia) is a starting point for finding sources, not an acceptable sole citation for the report.

verifiedBy.description: Team member who checked this against the source.

effects.description: Stat deltas, keyed by statId declared in the level file.

grants.description: Preparation flags set by this choice.

revokes.description: Preparation flags removed by this choice. Legal only on a trap card — flags are otherwise sticky.

outcome.description: In-game consequence of THIS choice. May be counterfactual.

effectReasons.description: WHY each stat moved, one bilingual chip per nonzero effect key (<= 8 words / ~60 chars per language). Required for every nonzero effect — the linter errors on a missing or orphaned reason. Shown on the outcome screen under each stat delta and in the run review; never on the mid-drag preview.

tag.description: One-word choice memory. Choosing this choice records chose:<tag> in the run; echoes and weave `conditions` reference it (e.g. card 11's sell choice declares tag 'sell' so noneOf:[chose:sell] can filter). The linter checks every referenced chose: token is declared by exactly one spine choice once cards exist.
